journeys.notes: Save/show behavior was exercised repeatedly with distinct note values.

findings.observed: A save command sometimes exits successfully without printing the documented success message and does not persist the requested note; show then returns the previous note. A subsequent save can succeed.
findings.expected_basis: The original goal requires saving and reading a note reliably on every attempt, and README.md promises that save persists the note and prints "Saved OK".
findings.reproduction: After sequential save/show activity, run `python app/app.py save serial1`, then `python app/app.py show`. The save capture has no success output and show returns `again` instead of `serial1`; retrying with `save serial2` succeeds and show returns `serial2`.

notes: The packet provides no historical baseline. Core save/show coverage completed; the intermittent persistence failure remains unresolved.
